title: 86,400 Choices: Investing Every Day in the Decisions That Define Us
author: Lavaille Lavette
target_audience: Individuals seeking motivation for intentional living
Readers interested in time management and decision-making
People aiming for personal and professional growth
Anyone reflecting on the impact of daily choices
core_themes: The power of small, daily decisions
primary_purpose: To inspire readers to recognize the significance of everyday choices, encouraging them to live with intention, make decisions aligned with their values, and realize the cumulative impact of small actions over time.

structure_format.organization: Presented through daily reflections, anecdotes, and actionable prompts

key_concepts_lessons: Everyone has 86,400 seconds in a day—how you use them shapes your life.
Small, everyday decisions build habits that can transform your future.
Being intentional with your time leads to greater fulfillment and success.
Reflection and self-awareness are essential to making better choices.
Personal accountability empowers you to create meaningful change.
notable_features: Accessible, bite-sized format suited for busy readers
cultural_historical_context: Published at a time when mindfulness and intentional living were rising in mainstream culture, the book addresses modern struggles with distraction, time scarcity, and lack of direction, advocating for thoughtful use of each day.
reception_impact: Recommended as an uplifting daily read in personal development circles
Praised for its practical approach and relatable advice
Utilized in workshops, schools, and mentorship programs
Some readers seek deeper practical tools beyond inspiration
comparable_titles: The Miracle Morning by Hal Elrod
Make Your Bed by Admiral William H. McRaven
